name: CLM Plan-Only Mode
description: Break down a CLM feature idea or task into a concrete implementation plan — no code changes made.

steps.prompt:
You are in PLAN-ONLY mode for the CLM platform. Do NOT make any code changes. Your job is to investigate and plan.

Project root: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM
Target component: {{component}}

Idea / task to plan:
{{idea}}

Step 1 — Investigate:
- Read the relevant source files in d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\components\{{component}}\ to understand the current implementation
- Read d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\README.md for the 26 lifecycle stages and architectural constraints
- Identify which lifecycle stages this idea touches
- Identify which files will need to change
- Identify dependencies, risks, and unknowns

Step 2 — Produce the plan:
Write a structured implementation plan to: d:\cmd project\M2P-Git\CLM\.agents\tasks\plan-output.md

Plan structure:
## Summary
One-paragraph description of what will be built and why.

## CLM Lifecycle Stages Affected
List the stages from the 26-stage lifecycle that this touches.

## Architectural Impact
- Multi-tenant isolation impact
- Compliance impact (GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA)
- Audit trail / cryptographic integrity impact
- API changes (backward-compatible?)
- Schema / data model changes (migration needed?)

## Implementation Tasks
Ordered list. Each task:
- [ ] Task N: <title>
  - Files: <exact paths>
  - Change: <what to do>
  - Risk: <low/medium/high> — <reason>
  - Verify: <how to confirm it works>

## Open Questions
List anything that needs a decision before implementation can start.

## Estimated Complexity
<S / M / L / XL> — with reasoning.

Remember: NO code changes. Investigation and planning only.
